snippet.title: IT HAS MY FACE - 1.0 LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
IT HAS MY FACE IS COMING OUT ON APRIL 3rd 2026!!!


Hello everyone!

We’re so excited to share our 1.0 launch trailer, showcasing all the features you can expect when the full version arrives on April 3rd!

If you want the full breakdown of everything included in 1.0, head over to our Steam news post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2506530?emclan=103582791474006053&emgid=532126482488623589

Thank you all so much for the love and support you’ve shown during Early Access. We can’t wait for the full game to be in your hands :)


Mark your calendars!
The IT HAS MY FACE team
